verdicts.why: In season 5 (his first season on file) Enoch is a Chronicom anthropologist who abducts Coulson's team and acts on his own mission, and in S6E7 he leaves FitzSimmons to find a home for his people; in S6E13 'New Life' he turns on the Hunters, sides with Fitz and Simmons, and from then on serves with the team (the wiki lists S.H.I.E.L.D. as his current affiliation). So he is not S.H.I.E.L.D. from the start, and he joins in season 6.

Cornell leads the Stokes Crime Family and owns Harlem's Paradise until Mariah kills him in Luke Cage S1; nothing on screen moves him back from the family to the club, and the wiki lists both as current affiliations. The third stage repeats one already held and has no move behind it.

Psylocke joins Apocalypse's Horsemen in X-Men: Apocalypse (her only title). By the end of the film Angel is dead, Magneto and Storm have turned, and Apocalypse is destroyed, so the group is gone. She then leaves without joining the X-Men, and the wiki lists the Horsemen as a former affiliation. The group ending counts as a move, so a stage moving her to Independent in the same title, plus a left entry, is right.
